correctness.rationale: Conditional on a specified chord, N=2n-2 endpoints are uniformly matched. Selecting x cross-pair endpoints, bijecting them, and internally matching parity-matched remaining endpoints gives the normalized factorial PMF on x=a(mod2),...,a. For a<=n-3, direct cancellation yields R_a(x)=[(a+2)(a+1)/(b(b-1))]*(b-x)/(a+2-x), which increases strictly since b>a+2. The additional atom at a+2 and chain transitivity prove the same-parity likelihood-ratio result; R-1 has sign (2n-1)x-b(a+2). X_1 is identically 1 whereas X_2 has positive atoms at 0,2, proving the sharp opposite-parity obstruction for all n>=3. Independent exact matching enumeration and rational arithmetic confirmed 2135 bounded identities; this does not replace proof at all n.
